column1: # writemorebetter concreteness ratings, AI-generated, 1 (abstract) to 5 (concrete), MIT OR Apache-2.0.
# Generated 2026-10-20 by prompting claude-fable-5-1 (3 samples), claude-opus-5-5 (3 samples), claude-sonnet-5-5 (3 samples)
# of style/data/baselines/overused-words.json without numerals and single letters, plus British spellings
# rated under their American lemma, and words-supplement.tsv (sha256 a0232fd2483e57ca28ad5ba48ae23df0543c77209f254b7206296948ef48de7c): 13 particles
# and adverbs that list leaves out but diction rates. Each model's ratings are averaged over its samples and z-scored, the
# models averaged, and the mean mapped to 1-5 by a linear fit to a 30% calibration split of the
# concreteness ratings in the Glasgow Norms (Scott, Keitel, Becirspahic, Yao & Sereno, 2019,
# 9e3295f4c804289fdd5fa36f2c5fe415826bef3d839702deedd51641b3ff9a39, CC BY 4.0), then rounded to one decimal.
# No Glasgow ratings are included. 1 value was adjudicated by hand
# claude-haiku-5-5 was also rated but is not used: sample-to-sample Spearman 0.933, below the 0.97 stability gate.
